source.title: Commencement Day: Six-Year Effects of a Freshman Learning Community Program at Kingsborough Community College

study.name: Opening Doors Learning Communities at Kingsborough Community College
study.design: Individual-level randomized comparison of program eligibility with standard Kingsborough courses and services

records.unit: Percentage-point difference in earning a degree at any college after six years, program minus control.
records.locator: Appendix Table C.8, printed p. 79 / PDF p. 102.

limits: Cost accounting compares group-level education resources and degree rates. It is not a benefit-cost ratio, general savings claim, or evidence for other learning-community trials.
